categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: cement manufacturing (including clinker production), premixed mortar and building materials, and interior decoration and design engineering through its subsidiaries. The cement segment supplies general construction and civil engineering projects, while the building materials segment focuses on premixed mortar products for construction finishing. The interior decoration segment provides integrated design and construction services for residential, commercial, and institutional spaces.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes rotary kiln technology operating at 1500°C for clinker production, enabling high-temperature decomposition of various waste materials. It employs automated production lines for premixed dry mortar, integrating vertical raw material supply chains for quality and cost control. R&D focuses on low-carbon cement, lightweight microbeads, high-performance mortars, offshore wind power grouting materials, and ultra-high-performance concrete (UHPC) with steel fiber reinforcement. Advanced testing and quality control technologies such as DTA, polarized microscopy, and MTBF analysis are applied.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction companies, ready-mix concrete plants, civil engineering contractors, and interior decoration clients. The cement products serve general construction, infrastructure, and green energy projects like offshore wind farms. Premixed mortar products target building finishing stages in residential and commercial projects. Interior decoration services cater to high-end residential, office buildings, commercial complexes, and public facilities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and sales are primarily focused in Taiwan, with cement sales concentrated in northern regions such as Yilan, Keelung, Taipei, Taoyuan, and Hsinchu. Premixed mortar and interior decoration services cover the entire island including offshore islands. The company also aims to expand offshore wind power material supply domestically and internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction materials supply chain. It produces raw cement clinker and finished cement products (midstream), manufactures premixed mortar and specialty building materials (midstream), and provides interior design and construction services (downstream). It sources raw materials like limestone, silica sand, iron slag, and gypsum from upstream suppliers and delivers products to end users in construction and engineering sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation in high-performance niche products, low-carbon and environmentally friendly building materials, and integration of green energy applications such as offshore wind power grouting materials. R&D efforts focus on developing lightweight microbeads for insulation and soundproofing, ultra-high-performance concrete with enhanced mechanical properties, and mechanized mortar products compatible with robotic application. The company also emphasizes sustainability, circular economy practices, and compliance with evolving environmental regulations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of cement, premixed mortar, and building materials. Additional income comes from contracting interior decoration and design engineering projects. The company also benefits from processing fees related to waste material recycling in cement production. Licensing or subscription models are not indicated.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in Taiwan’s premixed mortar market with over 50% market share under its '泰固美特耐' brand. In the cement industry, it competes within a mature, capital-intensive domestic market with stable demand. Its vertical integration, strong R&D capabilities, and focus on green building materials differentiate it from competitors. The interior decoration segment faces intense price competition but leverages reputation and integrated service offerings to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal year 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$6.67 billion, a 21% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to owners of NT$187.5 million, up 63%. Operating profit margin improved to 6%, and earnings per share reached NT$1.25. The company has shown steady growth in production and sales volumes across segments, supported by stable capital structure and increased equity from subsidiaries.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product quality stability, vertical integration of raw materials, and innovation in environmentally friendly and high-performance building materials. Its premixed mortar products offer superior consistency and ease of use compared to traditional site-mixed materials. The development of specialized products like offshore wind power grouting materials and UHPC with enhanced mechanical properties provides competitive differentiation. Comprehensive interior decoration services integrate aesthetics with structural and mechanical considerations, ensuring high customer satisfaction and repeat business.
